tagline: Fight giants outside. Destroy them within.
visual_concept: A monumental marble Titan frames a golden time-sun seal while a tiny unarmed Keeper awakens the Aion spark. The seal combines a clock face, a controlled breach and divine sunlight; it communicates the game's scale, mythic sky-world and outside-to-inside transformation without depicting or claiming a gameplay screen.

assets.safe_zone: The time-sun seal and Aion spark remain inside the central adaptive-icon safe zone; the Titan and Keeper extremities provide intentional mask overscan.

assets.color_contract: Single white silhouette on transparency; Android supplies the themed colors.

assets.typography: Custom vector paths; no font dependency

assets.disclosure: Illustrative key art, not a gameplay screenshot
Illustrative key art, not a gameplay screenshot
Original static brand treatment; raster exports are generated from this vector source

production_rules.app_icon: Export opaque at 1024x1024 in sRGB. Do not add rounded corners; store platforms apply their own masks.
production_rules.adaptive_icon: Keep the time-sun seal and Aion spark in the central safe zone. Validate foreground against circle, squircle and rounded-square masks, plus Android themed monochrome mode.
production_rules.wordmark: Preserve the original proportions and clear space equal to at least one glyph-I width.
production_rules.store_graphics: Verify current platform dimensions and file-size requirements immediately before submission.
production_rules.screenshots: Never use the feature graphic or social card as a gameplay screenshot.
production_rules.edits: Preserve the sky, marble, bronze, aqua, coral, gold and deep-blue-outline roles; do not restore dark-biopunk, bone-monster or iris imagery.

provenance.method: Original hand-authored SVG geometry created as project source code
